prompts.hero:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Original cutout illustration for a software engineering student's GitHub profile README. It will be integrated next to real typography, so the silhouette must float naturally over both light and dark pages.
Primary request: A beautifully art-directed miniature backend developer's workbench, a tactile editorial illustration with an actual transparent background.
Subject: One warm ivory retro computer with a deep forest-green screen showing only a tiny mint ">_" prompt. A compact cream mechanical keyboard in front. An elegant coral-red angled task lamp leans over it. A small stack of textured notebooks, one open with a few fine pencil diagrams, and a mint-green ceramic pencil cup. A small terracotta cable gently curls out to the left like a drawn flourish. Tiny brass details, a single pale yellow sticky note, nothing cluttered.
Style: Sophisticated stop-motion set design photographed like a luxury editorial still life. Sculpted paper and matte painted wood, visible paper fibers, restrained handmade imperfections, crisp and softly shaded. Charming and personal, not a generic 3D tech icon, not plastic, not glossy. No cartoon people, no logos, no floating UI cards, no clouds, no gradients behind the subject, no neon, no blue-purple tech glow.
Composition: Landscape 3:2 canvas. A close, slightly elevated three-quarter view; the entire compact arrangement fully visible with breathing room around its silhouette. Groundless isolated composition with a small soft contact shadow ONLY immediately beneath the objects. More open space on the left where the loose cable ends. Interesting asymmetrical silhouette and sculptural light.
Palette: warm bone white, pale sage, deep bottle green, burnt coral, tiny ochre accents. Warm natural studio light.
Text: Only ">_" on the monitor. No other lettering, no watermark.
Background: Genuinely transparent alpha, not a drawn checkerboard, no rectangular backdrop, no white background. Preserve translucent edges and shadows.

The accompanying reference image is style and materials guidance only; do not reproduce its computer, lamp, plant or arrangement.
Composition: Square canvas, isolated compact arrangement, very clearly readable at 180px display width. The objects occupy about 80% of the canvas, full silhouettes visible, close three-quarter view. Soft warm studio light; only a very small contact shadow.

Background: Actual transparent alpha. No rectangular backdrop, no environment, no glow or broad hazy shadow, no checkerboard. No logos or text except the tiny "$ _" prompt.

prompts.community:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Transparent cutout illustration beside a student community section in a personal GitHub README.

Composition: Square transparent canvas. All objects completely in frame with breathing room; noticeboard fills center-left and paper plane lifts into upper-right. Reads clearly at 165px width. Three-quarter view, soft warm studio light, only a delicate shadow immediately beneath the object.

Constraints: Actual transparent alpha background. No wall, no floor plane, no broad halo, no checkerboard, no text, no logos, no people, no glossy plastic, no neon.
prompts.copyright:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a small transparent illustration beside the final copyright section of a GitHub profile README.
Create one new original illustration. The reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its tactile miniature objects, matte ivory paper, muted sage surfaces, aged brass, warm coral detail, softly lit realistic materials, and clean readable silhouette. Do not recreate the filing drawers.
Subject: a short stack of ivory manuscript pages inside a closed sage book-cover folder, held shut by a single thin coral ribbon, with a small elegant brass padlock resting against the front. One softly curled paper corner shows through. A compact composition that quietly suggests authorship and keeping personal work safe.
Composition: three-quarter view, centered isolated object, generous transparent breathing room, no cropping. This will appear as a modest sticker overlapping a horizontal heading rule at approximately 170 pixels wide. Favor a simple silhouette, not tiny decorative detail. Warm directional light from upper left, restrained soft contact shadow only immediately beneath the object. Let the folder, pages, ribbon and lock form one coherent small arrangement.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha channel, no backdrop, no floor rectangle, no white field, no checkerboard pattern. This must blend into both white and very dark page backgrounds.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, shields, gavels, scales of justice, police motifs, neon, floating symbols, extra keys, seals, decorative plants. Do not suggest official certification or legal registration. Output a square transparent PNG.

additions.tree:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Transparent social-link tree for the bottom of a GitHub README; continuing an established physical workbench theme.
Primary request: An exquisitely crafted small spreading tree made of warm wood, brass wire and folded sage paper leaves, with THREE large completely blank cream leaf-shaped paper tags hanging from separate branches. This should feel like a real handmade desktop sculpture photographed in warm studio light, like paper and wooden models for a stop-motion film.
Composition: Landscape 3:2 canvas. Tree fully in frame with generous transparent margins. Symmetric overall triangular spreading silhouette but organic branching details. Exactly three large blank cream leaves/tags: one in the left third centered near 20% width and 40% height, one in the center third centered near 50% width and 23% height, one in the right third centered near 80% width and 40% height. These tags are broad, nearly horizontal and front-facing with clean light surfaces suitable for adding short text later, each around one fifth of the canvas width. No part of any large tag crosses the vertical boundaries at 33% and 67% of the image width. Fine branches lead from each tag to a lovely single warm wooden trunk in the center at the bottom. Smaller sage folded paper leaves cluster around the three big cream leaves, preserving those clean blank surfaces. Small coral string ties and tiny brass details.
At bottom: the trunk grows from a low round terracotta pot with moss, resting on one thin cream notebook. Only a few small leaves at its foot.
Style: Tactile editorial still life, visible paper fibers, natural wood, matte surfaces, sophisticated warm materiality. Match the reference image's palette and materials only, without copying its objects.
Palette: deep bottle green, sage, ivory, terracotta, warm oak and brass.
Lighting: warm soft studio lighting, grounded contact shadow immediately beneath pot only.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no wall, no rectangle, no broad colored halo, no drawn checkerboard. No text, no lettering, no logos, no humans, no glossy plastic, no neon.
treeBackgroundEdits: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied social tree illustration. Output a true RGBA PNG cutout with transparent pixels outside the objects. Keep only a delicate contact shadow under the notebook. Preserve the exact 1536 by 1024 composition and all objects.

additions.signoff: Create a transparent-background PNG cutout illustration for the closing signature of a GitHub README. A lovely ivory paper airplane with visible folded paper fibers, pointing gently up and right, trailing one loose looping coral thread. The thread is tied to a tiny brass key and one small sage leaf below the plane. An elegant, compact physical still life, handcrafted matte paper, warm brass and natural textures. Warm soft editorial studio lighting, delicate dimensional shadows on the folds. Objects only, isolated with real transparent alpha around every edge. Landscape composition with the entire plane and thread fully visible, plenty of breathing space. No background, no text, no logos, no wall or floor. Match the warm ivory, coral, sage and brass materials of the reference workbench, without copying any of its objects.
